checklist.requirement: Canonical namespaced game/player/team IDs and frozen crosswalk; unresolved identities never guessed.
checklist.acceptance: Verify uniqueness, alias joins, persistent player identity and unresolved-player propagation.

checklist.requirement: UTC information cutoff, availability evidence, hashed frozen inputs and versioned code/config/runtime/mode.
checklist.acceptance: Recompute manifest/run hashes and reject post-cutoff or as-of-unverified inputs.

checklist.requirement: Stable forecast/trial IDs and explicitly derived per-trial seeds.
checklist.acceptance: Replay the same trial across retry and worker order with the frozen RNG/runtime.

checklist.requirement: Explicit regulation/quarter/halftime/OT clocks and possession transitions; incomplete draws flagged.
checklist.acceptance: Check boundary attribution, 3600 regulation seconds, possession time partition and cap termination.

checklist.requirement: Team/player additive period accounting and score-credit reconciliation.
checklist.acceptance: Check H1=Q1+Q2, H2=Q3+Q4, REG=H1+H2, FG=REG+OT for both teams and player stats.

checklist.requirement: Player TARGETS and CARRIES generated before their yards with shared state/depth/rotation uncertainty and provenance.
checklist.acceptance: Inspect causal stage traces; reject yard-derived opportunities and unsupported measured-role claims.

checklist.requirement: Dropback/pass/rush classification conserves attempts, including throwaways, spikes, sacks, scrambles, kneels and aborted/trick plays.
checklist.acceptance: Evaluate all section-5 attempt equations per team/trial/period and check no-play exclusions.

checklist.requirement: Eligible-target/catch/carry and player-to-team yard conservation with explicit residual/credit adjustments.
checklist.acceptance: Check catches<=targets, all count/yard equations, zero-opportunity players and unassigned/lateral/fumble credits.

checklist.requirement: Versioned joint trial schema and identical trial population for Ghost6 and BetGuru.
checklist.acceptance: Validate required fields/types/unique keys and exact trial-ID joins; prohibit independent resampling.

checklist.requirement: Coverage UNKNOWN; routes MISSING; personnel 11/12/13 MISSING; no fabrication or unsupported effects.
checklist.acceptance: Trace explicit null/status/source records through producer and both adapters.

checklist.requirement: Quote timestamp/book/stat/period/line/side/price and rule identity; exact both-side/all-outcome pairing; mismatches=NOLINE.
checklist.acceptance: Check matching and deliberate missing/mismatched identity, timestamp, line, OT and settlement cases.

checklist.requirement: Frozen forecast IDs, disjoint train/dev/holdout game-ID manifests and inspected-data exclusions; no calibration edits.
checklist.acceptance: Check split disjointness, frozen lineage, game-group isolation and UNASSIGNED/inspected status handling.

checklist.requirement: Phase 1 documentation only; preserve all explicit scope exclusions.
checklist.acceptance: Review authorized output files and confirm no engine/calibration/odds/betting/cloud changes.

quote_nullable_fields.book_market_id: Null with missing-source flag if source did not supply an ID.
quote_nullable_fields.line: Null only for genuinely lineless markets under existing rules.

split_ids_note: Null means authoritative IDs not assigned in phase 1; it is not an empty verified split.
schema_note: This is a machine-readable acceptance checklist; the normative typed wire contract is section 6 of core_contract.md.
